{{Otheruses|Mite}}
The '''Balanoro Force mites''' were insects native to [[Balanor]]. The they fed on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] within a target range. They live deep in the jungles. It creates its share of annoyance and embarrassment. The Force mite is a tiny, winged creature with a pair of odd proboscises and numerous legs. It is resistant to various climate conditions and, if attached to a subject, does not require food or oxygen. It prefers warm, wet climates, and, unlike most insects, does not travel in swarms.
